claim_text: Spatial transcriptomics preserves tissue architecture but does not by itself recover adaptive receptor lineage identity.
why_it_matters_for_sirap: Frames the core gap between spatial expression and receptor sequence identity.

claim_text: AIRR-seq reveals BCR/TCR clonal structure, somatic mutation, and lineage history, but conventional workflows usually lose tissue coordinates.
why_it_matters_for_sirap: Explains what receptor sequencing adds and what it lacks.

claim_text: spAIRR analysis needs an end-to-end path from raw reads to coordinate-aware AIRR tables and spatial clone/lineage analyses.
why_it_matters_for_sirap: Directly motivates SIRAP as a toolkit rather than a single plot function.

claim_text: Myasthenia gravis thymus can contain ectopic germinal centers implicated in local autoreactive B-cell responses.
why_it_matters_for_sirap: Justifies the MG thymus as the main biological test case.

claim_text: Human tonsil provides a canonical germinal center comparator for ectopic thymic GCs.
SIRAP has two arms: processing spAIRR data through RAD interfaces and downstream AIRR pipelines, then visualizing/analyzing spatial receptor data.
why_it_matters_for_sirap: States the contribution in the introduction.
notes: Use local package docs and manuscript results.

claim_text: SPaCeD is a distinct spatial heavy/light pairing method that SIRAP re-implements/integrates for use within spAIRR workflows.
why_it_matters_for_sirap: Keeps the pairing method attribution clean.

claim_text: RAD is a companion demultiplexing/read-structure package that SIRAP wraps from R.
why_it_matters_for_sirap: Keeps RAD attribution clean and distinct from SIRAP.
